entries.content:
The term "Descender" is used to refer to a select group of extraordinary individuals who hail from outside the world of Teyvat. These outlanders possess a unique ability to transcend the established "laws" that govern the world, setting them apart from the native inhabitants.

The origins of the Descender epithet are shrouded in mystery, though it seems to have roots in the parlance of the enigmatic nation of Khaenri'ah. The Eleven Fatui Harbingers, co-founded by a former Khaenri'ahn royal mage, as well as independent researchers like Rene, are known to utilize this terminology.

What defines a Descender is their capacity to operate beyond the constraints that bind the people of Teyvat. Their memories, knowledge, and even the very information about them are unaffected by the tampering of Irminsul, the world's collective memory. This anomalous trait suggests Descenders possess a "will that can rival an entire world," as Rene's research has concluded.

The Traveler, is identified as the Fourth Descender, while the mysterious Heavenly Principles is believed to be the First. Intriguingly, not all who hail from outside Teyvat are considered Descenders - the criteria for this designation remains elusive.

One potential shared characteristic among Descenders is an innate affinity for elemental power. The revelation that the remains of the Third Descender were used to create the Gnoses, which can enhance elemental abilities, has led to speculation that this may be a unifying trait. However, there is no evidence that individuals born within Teyvat can ever attain the status of Descender.
